environment.description: ECS Fargate service behind ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. WebACL includes a custom rule group 'profile-update-body-inspection' with priority 1 that uses a JsonBody match scope targeting $.fields with a regex pattern set matching keys: (role|is_admin|suspended|quota) in a SizeConstraint + RegexPatternSet combination. The rule action is BLOCK with custom response code 403. Additionally, the WebACL has the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 10 with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule in COUNT mode (not block). The Kafka topic has an ACL that only permits writes from the ECS task role ARN, but the WAF intercepts before the request reaches the application. Note: the WAF rule inspects the FIRST 8KB of body content only (default body inspection limit) and uses FieldToMatch type JsonBody with MatchScope=VALUE and InvalidFallbackBehavior=MATCH.

config.kafka_acl: ALLOW only arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ecs-user-processor-task for WRITE on user-updates
config.network: public subnet, ALB with WAF, ECS in private subnet
